hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: Set only by the combined pipeline after validating the banner release tuple.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_ROLLOUT_TUPLE_SHA256
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Canonical digest emitted by the banner rollout validator.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: BANNER_BACKEND_HEALTH_ATTESTATION
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Set by the combined pipeline only after the backend deployment job returns healthy.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
if [[ "${BANNER_ROLLOUT:-false}" == "true" ]]; then if [[ ! "${BANNER_ROLLOUT_TUPLE_SHA256:-}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then echo "ERROR: banner rollout requires an exact validated tuple SHA-256." >&2 exit 2 fi if [[ "${BANNER_BACKEND_HEALTH_ATTESTATION:-}" != "OPERATIONS_GATEWAY_PSAMA_HEALTHY" ]]; then echo "ERROR: banner frontend publication requires verified Operations, Gateway, and PSAMA health." >&2 exit 2 fi fi
: "${TARGET_STACK:?TARGET_STACK is required}" : "${S3_BUCKET_NAME:?S3_BUCKET_NAME is required}" stack_s3_bucket="${S3_BUCKET_NAME}"
# Source folder containing the scripts source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/"
# Iterate through the files in the folder and source them shopt -s nullglob for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [ -f "$script_file" ] && [ -x "$script_file" ]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" # shellcheck source=/dev/null source "$script_file" fi done shopt -u nullglob
for fn in assume_role wait_for_command reset_role; do if ! command -v "${fn}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERROR: required function '${fn}' is not loaded from ${source_scripts_folder}" >&2 exit 1 fi done
assume_role
# Download the terraform state file echo "Download terraform.tfstate file for $TARGET_STACK stack" aws s3 cp "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/deployment_state_metadata/${TARGET_STACK}/terraform.tfstate" terraform.tfstate
# Extract the Wildfly EC2 instance ID echo "Extract HTTPD instance ID for $TARGET_STACK stack" httpd_instance_id=$(jq -r '.outputs["httpd-ec2-id"].value' terraform.tfstate) echo "${httpd_instance_id}"
update_httpd_container="sudo sh /opt/picsure/deploy-httpd.sh --stack_s3_bucket $stack_s3_bucket --target_stack $TARGET_STACK" echo "$update_httpd_container"
update_httpd_container_json=$(jq -n --arg cmd "$update_httpd_container" '{commands: [$cmd]}') echo "JSON version of run command: $update_httpd_container_json"
command_id=$(aws ssm send-command \ --instance-ids "${httpd_instance_id}" \ --document-name "AWS-RunShellScript" \ --comment "Deploy httpd in place" \ --parameters "$update_httpd_container_json" \ --query "Command.CommandId" \ --output text)
wait_for_command "${command_id}" "${httpd_instance_id}"
reset_role
